locations.notes: Snippets are JSON he authored himself — his own code, safe to carry over.
settings.json / keybindings.json are plain JSON he wrote — validate they parse, then reapply. Settings Sync state is machine-keyed; use Settings Sync export instead of copying its blobs.
CachedData, GPU caches, logs, and workspace storage are rebuilt. Workspace storage can hold extension state blobs — never restore blindly.
Extension folders are marketplace binaries in a user-writable dir — a persistence favorite. Reinstall extensions from the marketplace; the app itself reinstalls via Chocolatey.
